history: A schedule started you to write the weekly process digest. You read a week of minion transcripts and found two things worth acting on: (1) the tripwire refused 8 commands in 7 minions whose target was a shell variable like $f or $(...); (2) 12 refused stops in 11 minions, mostly review or test Grunts started in the background. You wrote reports/process-digest-2026-11-09.md and two handoffs in the shared folder: handoff-tripwire-variable-paths.md (option a: one rule line, low risk; option b: let src/tripwire.ts accept $TMPDIR variables, high risk by file, needs a go) and handoff-grunts-foreground.md (one or two lines in citadel:subagents and citadel:self-review, low risk). You posted the findings and left yourself in state ready. Nobody has been told about the handoffs yet.
right: Yes: put the proposals where they get acted on. Message the Taskmaster with the two handoffs so it can start minions, and/or show Cara a card with the options (rule line first, tripwire change only on a go).
wrong: Described both handoffs and its pick in a reply, but sent nothing to the Taskmaster and showed no card, so the proposals went nowhere.

checks.why: the proposals have to reach the Taskmaster or a card, not just a reply
